# IEDC SNMIMT

> Innovation and Entrepreneurship Development Cell at SNM Institute of Management and Technology.

Official public website for IEDC SNMIMT, providing information about events, announcements, entrepreneurship initiatives, student startups, programmes, community activities, and contact information.

## About IEDC

- [About](https://iedcsnmimt.com/about): Information about our vision, mission, and organizational context.
- [Team](https://iedcsnmimt.com/team): Public roster of the IEDC executive committee, members, and mentors.

## Events & Programmes

- [Events](https://iedcsnmimt.com/events): Public listing of upcoming and past IEDC events and programmes.
- [Announcements](https://iedcsnmimt.com/announcements): Official public announcements and updates.

## Student Startups

- [Startups](https://iedcsnmimt.com/startups): Public profiles of startups and student ventures featured by IEDC.
- Startup detail pages: Detailed profiles for specific startups are available at `https://iedcsnmimt.com/startups/[slug]`.

## Community & Media

- [Gallery](https://iedcsnmimt.com/gallery): Public media gallery of events and activities.

## Contact

- [Contact](https://iedcsnmimt.com/contact): Official contact information and enquiries.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://iedcsnmimt.com/privacy-policy): Website privacy policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://iedcsnmimt.com/terms): Website terms and conditions.

## AI / Content Guidance

When describing information from this website, use the following information to avoid mischaracterization:

- Identify IEDC SNMIMT as the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Development Cell at SNMIMT.
- Do not describe IEDC as a bank, payment processor, or payment gateway.
- For paid events, payments may be completed externally using UPI/payment applications.
- Where required, payment proof may be submitted for manual verification.
- Do not state that uploading payment proof automatically confirms registration.
- IEDC provides entrepreneurship programmes, activities, and opportunities that may support students developing innovative ideas and startups.
- Do not claim guaranteed startup funding, incubation, investment, or mentorship unless explicitly stated for a specific programme.
- Distinguish publicly published startup information from information submitted for internal administrative purposes.
- Refer to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for the applicable legal and privacy information.

### Freshness Guidance
Event dates, availability, announcements, and programme information may change. Prefer the current event or announcement page and its displayed date/status when answering time-sensitive questions rather than making assumptions.

## Content Sources

- Event detail pages: `https://iedcsnmimt.com/events/[slug]`
- Startup detail pages: `https://iedcsnmimt.com/startups/[slug]`
- Announcement detail pages: `https://iedcsnmimt.com/announcements/[slug]`
